title: Universo → seleção → quebras
use: Macro to micro: time of the full find, time of the refined selection, then 2 or 4 category breaks. Default is importer,exporter,market,state (2 series + 2×2 bars). Classic two-break: importer,exporter. origin/country alias to market. Attribute/brand/model are refine filters, not extra bar charts.
